question: nearest river to country ZMB
sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE iso_a3 = 'ZMB'
), cent AS (
  SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS pt FROM c
)
SELECT r.name,
       ST_Distance_Sphere(cent.pt, r.geometry) AS dist_m,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(r.geometry) AS river_geojson
FROM rivers r, cent
ORDER BY dist_m
LIMIT 1;

question: countries within 100 km of river Amazon
sql:
SELECT c.name,
       c.iso_a3,
       ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) AS dist_m
FROM countries c
JOIN rivers r ON r.name = 'Amazon'
WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) <= 100000
ORDER BY dist_m;

question: top 5 longest rivers within 200 km of point (12.5, -8.5)
sql:
WITH pt AS (SELECT ST_Point(12.5, -8.5) AS geom),
     r_filtered AS (
       SELECT r.*, 
              ST_Distance_Sphere(r.geometry, pt.geom) AS dist_m
       FROM rivers r, pt
       WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(r.geometry, pt.geom) <= 200000
     )
SELECT name,
       ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry, 'WGS84') AS length_m,
       dist_m
FROM r_filtered
ORDER BY length_m DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: countries with GDP > 1 trillion within 300 km of Nile
sql:
WITH nile AS (
  SELECT geometry FROM rivers WHERE name = 'Nile'
)
SELECT c.name,
       c.iso_a3,
       c.gdp_md,
       ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, nile.geometry) AS dist_m
FROM countries c, nile
WHERE c.gdp_md > 1000000
  AND ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, nile.geometry) <= 300000
ORDER BY dist_m;

question: nearest 3 countries to Danube source point
sql:
WITH danube AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(geometry) AS src FROM rivers WHERE name = 'Danube'
), centroids AS (
  SELECT iso_a3, name, ST_Centroid(geometry) AS pt FROM countries
)
SELECT c.iso_a3,
       c.name,
       ST_Distance_Sphere(danube.src, c.pt) AS dist_m
FROM danube, centroids c
ORDER BY dist_m
LIMIT 3;

question: total river length (km) per subregion within 50 km of any coastline
sql:
WITH countries_metric AS (
  SELECT subregion,
         ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS geom_m
  FROM countries
),
buffers AS (
  SELECT subregion,
         ST_Union_Agg(ST_Buffer(geom_m, 50000)) AS buf
  FROM countries_metric
  GROUP BY subregion
),
river_metric AS (
  SELECT name,
         ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS geom_m
  FROM rivers
)
SELECT b.subregion,
       SUM(ST_Length(ST_Intersection(r.geom_m, b.buf))) / 1000.0 AS river_km
FROM buffers b
JOIN river_metric r ON ST_Intersects(r.geom_m, b.buf)
GROUP BY b.subregion
ORDER BY river_km DESC;
